items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: I think one of the first jobs I booked was myself and Raymond, a guy named Lou Castillo on drums, and Tester Craig played the bass fiddle, Gene Hemart played the guitar. And then I started using the name of Red Heart and his Red Heart band.

ctx.x: It helps out a little bit. So I came back from the Coast Guard and I hadn't played for about a year or two and Leonard Wiley calls me and asks me if I wanted to play with the Leon Rapolo. Now not the original Leon Rapolo. This is the Leon Rapolo that used to direct the five piece band with the baton in the beginning. Don't laugh now. This is me recording. Okay I won't laugh anymore. You're laughing at my antics, not the- No, I just heard that story so many times. So anyway, it was good that I worked with him. I…
